overview_description.description: Radar specializes in providing location data infrastructure and tools for app developers to integrate location-based services in their applications. The platform offers geofencing, location tracking, and proximity solutions that enable developers to create personalized and contextually aware app experiences. Radar supports various use cases, including retail, travel, logistics, and more, by offering APIs and SDKs for easy integration. The company focuses on privacy and security, ensuring that location data is handled with care.

about_short_description.short_description: Radar offers location data infrastructure for apps, enabling geofencing, tracking, and proximity services.

product.name: Geofencing Platform
product.description: A platform providing geofencing capabilities to detect and respond to user location events within defined geographic boundaries.

product.name: Maps Platform
product.description: A suite of mapping services including vector base maps, geocoding, routing, address autocomplete, and address validation APIs.

product.name: Fraud Detection and Geo-Compliance Solution
product.description: A geolocation-based solution to detect location spoofing and ensure compliance with geographic restrictions, especially for gaming and regulated industries.

product.name: Trips
product.description: A service for tracking trips with live estimated times of arrival (ETAs) and arrival detection to support logistics and pickup experiences.

product.name: Places
product.description: A service that identifies and manages points of interest and geofenced locations to enable location-aware app experiences.
